why: fm-server 4.30 answers a LIMIT's sender with what it did on arrival -- filledUnits, averagePrice, and for IOC cancelledUnits -- and names a time-in-force other than GTC. submitMarket tells a server that ignored timeInForce, and so left the remainder resting, by filledUnits being absent; an SDK that drops the field cancels an order that never rested, and a caller reading the fill reads nothing.

source.constructed: fm-server 4.30 is unreleased (fm-server c27f89a60, fm-server#1035); the shape is its OrderDto as WireManifestTest holds it. Recapture from POST /v1/marketplaces/{marketplaceId}/orders once it is deployed.
